title: An arpeggiated chord and a non-arpeggio bracket
description: Two half-note triads: the first arpeggiated upward with an arrow (the wavy line), the second explicitly NOT arpeggiated (the square bracket that cancels a prevailing arpeggiation). Both live on the part measure, positioned rhythmically and spanning note ids from bottom to top — the id-pair span is what lets one chord of a multi-voice stack arpeggiate without the others. Neither mark is drawn yet; the goldens pin the plain chords and move when arpeggio rendering lands.
